summary: Frontend-only testing of Applications page redesign. Verified hero carousel (auto-rotation, dot navigation, side icon navigation), industry grid with 6 cards linking to detail pages, inspirations gallery with modal functionality, CTA buttons, mobile responsiveness, and all 10 industry detail pages.

issues: Some images have white backgrounds (LED panel product shots) - noted as data quality issue in database, not code bug

features_tested.details: Carousel auto-rotates every 5 seconds. Verified title changed from 'Shopfront Signage' to 'Hospitality & Hotels' after 6 seconds.
4 navigation dots visible at bottom of carousel. Clicking dots changes displayed industry.
4 side navigation icons (desktop only) allow switching between featured industries.
6 application cards displayed with data-testid attributes (healthcare, transportation, entertainment, sports-events, education, outdoor-billboards). Each shows image, title, description, and specs.
Clicking Healthcare card navigated to /applications/healthcare correctly with proper detail page content.

All 10 detail pages load correctly: shopfront-signage, hospitality, retail-malls, corporate, healthcare, transportation, entertainment, sports-events, education, outdoor-billboards. Each has unique specs, challenges, solutions, and FAQs.
Project Gallery section displays with 'ALL PROJECTS' filter button and 12 inspiration items visible.
Clicking inspiration item opens modal with image, title, and description. Modal shows 'IMMERSIVE RETAIL EXPERIENCE' content.
Previous and Next navigation buttons visible in modal. Navigation arrows positioned on left and right.
Close button (X) in top-right corner closes modal.
Cyan 'GET QUOTE' button links to /contact and navigates correctly.
'VIEW CASE STUDIES' button links to /case-studies and navigates correctly.
Page displays correctly on mobile (390x844). Hero carousel shows with dots, industry cards stack vertically, sticky bottom buttons (WhatsApp, GET QUOTE) visible.

design_verification.hero_carousel: Dramatic hero with background images, gradient overlays, featured industry content, stats (brightness, pixel pitch)
design_verification.industry_grid: Bento-style grid with larger featured cards, hover effects with cyan border glow
design_verification.inspirations_gallery: Masonry grid with hero items, zoom-in icon on hover, tag pills
design_verification.cta_section: Full-width glassmorphism card with 'READY TO TRANSFORM YOUR SPACE?' heading
design_verification.mobile_layout: Cards stack vertically, navigation collapses to hamburger menu, sticky CTA buttons

context_for_next_testing_agent: ApplicationsIndex.js redesign tested and working. Hero carousel with 4 featured industries auto-rotates and has dot/icon navigation. Industry grid shows 6 cards (healthcare through outdoor-billboards) - the first 4 industries are featured in the hero carousel. Inspirations gallery fetches from API and displays properly with modal. All 10 industry detail pages verified working. CTA buttons navigate correctly to /contact and /case-studies. Note: Some inspiration gallery images have white backgrounds which is a data quality issue, not a code bug.
